messages:
Julia Chen: FYI — Satori's Field CTO is asking for our SOC 2 Type II report + a signed NDA before legal will proceed. They're pressing on timeline, deal looks at risk if we can't produce something quick.
Samir Patel: We shouldn't hand over the full report without NDA. Options: redacted SOC2 PDF + standard mutual NDA, or a bridge letter / interim attestation from security until next audit artifacts are available.
Devon Reyes: We have a bridge-letter template in the security repo. Internal path: https://redwood.internal/docs/security/bridge_letter_template_v3.docx (internal). Also can export a CAIQ snapshot if they want control-level mapping.
Marta Lopez: Customer says they need "signed attestation or SOC2" within 30 days to sign the SOW. Can we commit to bridge-letter + redacted report within that window?
Priya Singh: Legal can approve a bridge letter but it needs a Jira intake: LEGAL-4321. NDA: use Mutual NDA v3 (approved). Full report only after NDA countersigned and redaction review. Expect ~3-5 business days turnaround for bridge letter once Jira is filed.
Samir Patel: I'll open LEGAL-4321 and attach the customer's email. Quick Q for security: can we redact auditor name/org or is that discouraged?
Devon Reyes: Redaction of sensitive PII and client-specific details is fine. Legal prefers we do NOT redact the audit firm name unless there's an explicit conflict. Bridge letter will call out scope & period (eg. Type II period Jan 1 2023–Dec 31 2023).
security-bot: Notice: SOC2 Type II (period: Jan 1 2023 - Dec 31 2023) — redacted copy available in secure drive. Bridge letter template v3.0 uploaded.
Julia Chen: Great — here's what I'll tell Satori: 1) sign NDA (link), 2) we can provide a redacted SOC2 PDF + bridge letter after NDA is countersigned, 3) CAIQ export available on request. Timeline: bridge letter in ~3-5 business days post-legal intake. Any issues?
Priya Singh: No issues. One legal ask: include clause in bridge letter that states "no material control exceptions identified subsequent to the report period to the best of our knowledge" — legal will edit language but include that intent. Also no raw audit workpapers shared.
Marta Lopez: Satori also asked about a temporary data-residency note for the POC (US-only). Can we add a POC SOW bullet stating ephemeral/short retention?
Samir Patel: Yes, I'll draft a short SOW snippet: ```POC data residency: US-central; data retention <= 7 days; inputs masked/hashed for demo; telemetry only for performance debugging.```
Julia Chen: :thumbsup: I'll send NDA link and set expectations. Samir — once LEGAL-4321 is created, ping here and I’ll escalate if we hear pushback.
Samir Patel: Done — Jira created and assigned to Priya. Attached customer email and specific deadline.
Priya Singh: Got it, reviewing now. Will aim to have a bridge-letter draft in 2-3 business days, then security will sign off.
Marta Lopez: Customer just confirmed they'll sign the NDA tonight.
Julia Chen: Perfect. Thanks team — will update after NDA is countersigned. (reaction: :pray:)
